reading.requirement: Exact source text hash and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Official Conversation MP3, current audio hash, alignment and rights checks must pass; no silent directions as evidence.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same source reading and audio share one exposure group; never count either as unseen after the other.

questions.prompt: Why is Anna nervous at the beginning?
options: She is reading the news for the first time.
She has missed an important interview.
She has lost a book for the show.
answers: She is reading the news for the first time.
questions.evidence: Today at work I am reading the news for the first time. I am really nervous.
questions.explanation: 开场把for the first time与nervous放在一起，说明她第一次播读新闻而紧张。对话没有说她错过采访或弄丢书。这里不要把后面的新闻故事内容误当作Anna自己遇到的工作问题。

spokenEvidence.quote: Today at work I am reading the news for the first time. I am really nervous.

questions.prompt: What rule does Caty give Anna for reading the news?
options: Add a personal opinion after every story.
Read facts without displaying personal feelings.
Use an excited voice for every event.
answers: Read facts without displaying personal feelings.
questions.evidence: When we read the news we are always reading facts. We never show our feelings.
questions.explanation: Caty用facts和feelings形成对比，要求播读事实，不展现个人情绪。always与never是本段教学情境中的明确要求，不能反过来选每篇都加个人意见或始终兴奋。题目问她给Anna的规则，不概括所有现实新闻工作。

spokenEvidence.quote: When we read the news we are always reading facts. We never show our feelings.

questions.prompt: What happens to the duckling in the first story Anna reads?
options: A family gives it a home.
answers: A family gives it a home.
questions.evidence: But a family gives him a home.
questions.explanation: 第一次故事说小鸭子迷路、母鸭找不到它，Anna重读时补充But a family gives him a home。所以后续事件是一个家庭收留它。比赛属于下一条新闻，动物园在这里没有出现。him在这一故事里指duckling。

spokenEvidence.quote: But a family gives him a home.

questions.prompt: What achievement is reported in the second story?
options: An older woman wins a car race.
An older woman publishes a children’s book.
An older woman opens a library.
answers: An older woman wins a car race.
questions.evidence: In Indiana, a grandmother is the first 80-year-old woman to win The Race Car 500.
questions.explanation: 第二条新闻报道一位80岁的祖母赢得赛车比赛。儿童书属于第一条新闻，图书馆资金属于第三条新闻；它们虽然都在同一对话里出现，却不是这位女性的成就。这里核对的是剧中读出的故事，不把它当现实新闻核验。

spokenEvidence.quote: In Indiana, a grandmother is the first 80-year-old woman to win The Race Car 500.

questions.prompt: Which service loses money to pay for the party in the third story?
questions.evidence: They are taking the money for the party from the children’s library.
questions.explanation: taking the money ... from说明资金来源是children’s library。因此受资金转移影响的是儿童图书馆，不是医院或学校体育社团。party和cruise ship说明资金去向，不能把去向与原来的服务项目混淆。

spokenEvidence.quote: They are taking the money for the party from the children’s library.

questions.prompt: What does Anna expect about the rest of her workday?
options: It will take a long time.
It will continue without any more practice.
answers: It will take a long time.
questions.evidence: This is going to be a very long day.
questions.explanation: 经过反复尝试与纠正，Anna说this is going to be a very long day，表达她预计这一天会很漫长。这里不是指一天的自然时长改变，而是工作还会持续很久；没有依据说她能提前结束或无需再练习。

spokenEvidence.quote: This is going to be a very long day.

review.textEvidence: Codex item-by-item source comparison; not human or psychometric calibration

blindComparison.scope: Source text only; not an actual listening check, human examiner review or difficulty calibration.
